failure_location.quote: When $q=0$, one recovers the exact manifold regression model where functions are supported exactly on a low-dimensional manifold.

issues.overall_effect: All prose interpreting q=0 as the exact-manifold case, including the corresponding interpretation of the generalization bound, is false under the stated definition.
issues.title: The defined tubular region is empty when q=0
issues.why_classification: A short boundary-case correction preserves the method, rates, and intended q=0 scope.

issues.failure_explanation: Under the stated block definition, the FFN output is added to Z=MHA(H)+H. The cited Gating Lemma outputs retained or zeroed token data; it does not output the correction needed to subtract DM from Z. Indeed, using its stated output in the residual block adds another copy on retained tokens rather than producing the displayed matrix. The same unsupported use of the FFN to alter selected tokens occurs throughout the arithmetic constructions.

issues.overall_effect: The basic arithmetic library is not proved for the transformer architecture as defined, so the partition-of-unity implementation and both main approximation and generalization results lose their constructive foundation.
issues.title: Arithmetic constructions misuse the residual feed-forward definition
issues.why_classification: All central constructions rely on the incompatible residual calculation, and the source supplies no corrected implementation; restoring the results requires rebuilding the arithmetic architecture and its complexity analysis.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: When calculating the transformer network parameters, we make the assumption that the logarithmic term $\ln(\frac{1}{\epsilon})$ is much smaller than the exponential term $\delta^{-d}$.
